dct_title_s: Pengilly Quadrangle, Minnesota - Itasca County, 1952: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Pengilly quadrangle topographic map (N4715-W9307.5/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in pencil and red ink regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the Pengilly area. The hand written notations include information on the following: logging camps noted with 'C'.
